[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Deprovan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She owned a pet [[Voorpak/Legends|voorpak]] which she named [[Ch. Empress Sunwinds Messenger Chung-Chung LaFlorin III. Dotty]].<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Deprovan was first mentioned in a [[W:c:swg:Mission Terminal|mission terminal]] [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />
